text:
Source-assisted reading (Vulgate, standard Mass formularies, Missale Pataviense 1498 ff. 85v-86r). Reread on the image by a research reader: canvas 3 col. a (whole column); canvas 2 col. a top and col. b top and foot; canvas 0 col. a foot and col. b middle. Reread by a second research reader: canvas 1 col. a lower half and col. b top (24 lines), canvas 0 col. a top. Everything else on canvas 1 rests on the image-only first reading. Regions are width x height at x,y in native pixels (4912 x 7360). ( ) expansion, [ ] lost or supplied, ? doubtful.
